new_capability: Link pre-result contract, generated action, tool pending/response and visible observation to subsequent saved requests without supplying semantic labels
distinctions: A generated tool action is not necessarily a recorded dispatch or completed execution
A saved request is not proof of successful server inference
A raw tool result can be withheld and therefore absent from subsequent model inputs
Reading a cache does not establish that the final answer applies it incompatibly
Forward contract visibility does not prove semantic consistency or causal mediation
Secondary full traces expose conditions; freeze primary label-masked review before consulting them

retained_development_failure.cause: Sorted journal object keys changed reserialized observation text order relative to the original saved request string
retained_development_failure.fix: Check new observation as strict structured JSON, preserve the actual saved request text, and require exact unchanged preceding message history

tests.scope: Mocked replies, synthetic local archives, in-memory tool fixtures; no live inference

archived_scripted_trace_check.scope: Replay of saved software-test records only, not new model or SQL execution

scientific_status: Cache-price-induced contract drift and incremental benefit beyond strong baselines remain untested
remaining_measurement_gate: Independent semantic review/adjudication and hash-bound import into fixed-pair descriptive summaries; do not fill missing labels automatically
